hero.subtitle: Seamlessly coordinate doctors, nurses, and pharmacists in one secure, role-protected clinical workspace. Real-time vital signs, consultation reports, and medication tracking.

features.title: Engineered for Clinical Excellence
features.desc: Everything your medical staff needs to deliver prompt, accurate, and coordinated patient care.
features.f1Desc: Fast, centralized intake with strict role-based access control protecting medical confidentiality at every step.
features.f2Desc: Instant logging of blood pressure, blood glucose, and consultation summaries with direct doctor-nurse synchronization.
features.f3Desc: Comprehensive drug inventory tracking and prescription delivery management directly handled by licensed pharmacists.

nurses.title: Our Dedicated Nurses

pharmacists.title: Our Pharmacist Team
pharmacists.desc: Ensuring safe medication delivery, prescription validation, and patient counseling.
